hero.description: Bridging traditional Chemical Engineering with Machine Learning and Advanced Analytics to optimize industrial systems.

about.paragraph1: I am an undergraduate specializing in Chemical and Process Engineering. My academic journey has provided me with a solid foundation in core engineering principles, including thermodynamics, process design, and transport phenomena.
about.paragraph2: Driven by the potential of Industry 4.0, I have proactively expanded my skillset to include Data Analysis and Machine Learning. I am deeply interested in applying data-driven intelligence—such as predictive maintenance, process optimization, and advanced control systems—to enhance the efficiency and sustainability of chemical plants.

projects.title: Industrial Process Data Analysis & Optimization
projects.description: Analyzed operational sensor data from chemical plant simulations to detect inefficiencies and predict equipment failures using Python.

projects.title: Predictive Maintenance Model for Industrial Pumps
projects.description: Built a machine learning classification model to forecast equipment breakdown based on operational vibration, pressure, and temperature telemetry.
